name: discord-server-management-bot
description: Discord.js v14 server management bot with Express API, Prisma/PostgreSQL, and Vite React dashboard.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w apps/backend" "npm run dev -w apps/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/backend && npm run build -w apps/frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/backend && npm run lint -w apps/frontend
